conclusions: Host wide-integer checks validate12720708 exact packed products and1318560 ordered carries,including52929 accepted and117631 rejected certificates. All15 native cases compare1881219 ordered states without differences; excluded rows and K4112 use original fallback. Both input buffers,row flags and every output/trace redzone pass.

Native parity was strengthened at3e8ba49 by resetting the production output to a sentinel before independent execution. The arithmetic header is identical to809a44e. Both native passes preserve all ordered values and production/diagnostic endpoints. The strengthened test changes no component or provider arithmetic.

The complete q8192 QKV run at809a44e compares unchanged producer algorithm4,PPB1000,midpoint512,4331311 original selected identities and67108864 GB10-comparable BF16 cells in all four variants. Every unrounded selected accumulator matches the control. Row certificates cover3458610 candidates,8080 weight rows and all8192 input rows; excluded rows retain original arithmetic.

Preparation plus replay medians are56.8519ms original,66.4194ms packed only,71.4928ms four-group tiles and71.0080ms eight-group tiles. Every candidate is slower. No variant enters product dispatch and these component clocks do not qualify inference or performance.

Full local checks pass382 Python tests with two skips,47 Rust tests,C ABI smoke,clippy and hygiene. The later test-only reset passes its native build/test. All model performance,context,package,HTTP and soak release gates remain open. Continue broader attention-pipeline changes with original ordered denominator and GB10 correctness gates.
